steps.python:
r = ${ran}
assert not r['failed'] and 'hello 42' in r['output'], r

assert '43' in ${evr}['output'], ${evr}
assert '>>> x + 1' in ${log}['text'], ${log}

import pathlib
pathlib.Path(r'${out}/bad.py').write_text("def f():
    raise ValueError('boom')

f()
")

r = ${badr}
assert r['failed'] and 'ValueError: boom' in r['output'] and 'bad.py", line 2' in r['output'], r
t = [t for t in ${tabs} if t['tab'] == ${bad.tab}][0]
assert [m['line'] for m in t['markers']] == [2] and 'boom' in t['markers'][0]['message'], t

t = [t for t in ${at} if t['active']][0]
assert t['tab'] == ${bad.tab} and t['line'] == 2, t

import pathlib, time
time.sleep(1.1)
pathlib.Path(r'${out}/bad.py').write_text("def f():
    return 'fixed'


print(f())
")

import time
tab = lambda: [t for t in app._run('script.tabs', {}, 'smoke')['value'] if t['tab'] == ${bad.tab}][0]
end = time.monotonic() + 15
while tab()['lines'] != 6 or tab()['markers'] or 'fixed' not in app._run('script.console', {'since': ${log.next}}, 'smoke')['value']['text']:
    assert time.monotonic() < end, tab()
    app.update(True)
assert not tab()['dirty'] and not tab()['disk_changed'], tab()
assert not ${dropped}['failed'] and 'dropped 8 boxes' in ${dropped}['output'], ${dropped}

b = ${bodies}
assert len(b) >= 8 and all(n['kind'] == 'body' for n in b), b

o = ${listed}['output']
assert not ${listed}['failed'] and ' nodes' in o and 'selected ' in o, o

import time
end = time.monotonic() + 30
while 'still running 20' not in app._run('script.console', {'since': 0}, 'smoke')['value']['text']:
    assert time.monotonic() < end
    app.update(True)
assert app.document()['script_busy_s'] > 0.0, app.document()

r = ${stopped}
assert r['failed'] and 'stopped by the user' in r['output'] and 'long_loop.py' in r['output'], r
assert ${budget}['failed'] and 'still running 0' in ${budget}['output'], ${budget}

t = ${samples}['text']
assert t.count('  state ') == 5 and 'sampling done' in t, t

args.code:
box = action('scene.spawn', kind='box', pose={'pos': [0.0, 0.0, 2.0], 'quat': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]})
move(box['focus'], [0.5, 0.5, 1.0])
select(box['focus'])
log('moved', box['focus'], level='warn')
args.name: <helpers>

steps.python: assert not ${helped}['failed'] and '[warn] moved' in ${helped}['output'], ${helped}

d = app.document()
assert d['selection'] and repr(d['selection']) in ${selr}['output'], (d['selection'], ${selr})

import pathlib
assert pathlib.Path(r'${out}/saved.py').read_text() == "x = 6 * 7\nprint('hello', x)\n"

r = app._run('script.load', {'path': ${scripts}[-1]['path']}, 'smoke')
assert r['ok'] and r['value']['title'], r
assert all(t['tab'] != ${bad.tab} for t in ${left}), ${left}
